fields.label: Summary
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the card

fields.label: Published
fields.description: Shows this article in the Published externally section of /articles

fields.label: Publisher
fields.description: Short name shown on the card and button, e.g. IDR or Indian Express

fields.label: Publisher Logo
fields.description: Upload the logo here so it is served from our site. Wide logos on a white or transparent background work best

fields.label: Article URL
fields.description: Full https:// link to the article on the publisher's site

fields.label: Published On
fields.description: Sets the order on the page, newest first

fields.label: Author
fields.description: Byline as shown on the card, e.g. Shweta Jain Chaudhury
